title: Registered Autopilot devices have no profile assigned

messages.businessImpact: These machines will provision as ordinary devices with no branding, no configuration and no enrolment status page. The user gets a consumer out of box experience on a company laptop.
remediation: Add the devices to the group the Autopilot profile targets, or widen the assignment.
If the group is dynamic, check its rule matches how these devices were registered.
messages.cannotSee: Intune reports whether a profile is assigned but does not return the profile's name with the registration, so the table says which hardware has none rather than which profile the rest got.
